inherit: All v12c seeds, temporal/support eligibility, Adam settings, batch sizes, 12 epochs, global standardized flow MAE, 0.001 regularization coefficient, selection constraints and paired bootstrap settings. Fit every arm afresh with the same per-seed sample permutation. Original A is frozen/eval.

architecture.features: F = [H_last, mean_time(H), H_last-H_first, three distances, report_age_minutes/5]. H is the frozen linear input embedding of local flow, before temporal/graph encoding.
architecture.value: V is the frozen native ICSF value projection of the report_location_v1 embedding (report age and forecast clock). No new severity/type/text/weather/speed/occupancy source is introduced.
architecture.strength: Exact original v12c node gate: F->16 Tanh->1, g=2 sigmoid(logit), LayerNorm(H_last+g*mask*V). 1633 parameters at H=32.
architecture.state_vector: u=tanh(Linear(F,H)); r=tanh(Linear(u,H)); delta=RMS(V)*r. 4288 parameters at H=32.
architecture.interaction_vector: Same tensors/init as state_vector, except output input is u*(1+tanh(V)). 4288 parameters at H=32; no trainable context projection.
architecture.vector_injection: LayerNorm((H_last+mask*V)+mask*delta). Both vector output layers start at exact zero. Keep original graph, normalization, decoder and TIID context. Each residual has norm <= norm(V). V=0 gives exact zero delta without epsilon scaling.
architecture.regularizer: strength: mean_candidate((g-1)^2), using original trainer; vectors: mean_candidate_channel(r^2). Both are normalized correction energy when V!=0. For V=0 vector r is still regularized, but applied delta is zero. Coefficient remains 0.001.
architecture.capacity_boundary: Only the two vector arms have matched capacity and initialization. Strength-vs-vector is not a parameter-count-controlled attribution. State_vector already sees age/distances and the RMS(V) scale; it is not incident-free. Interaction-vs-state tests additional frozen context conditioning, not multiplication versus every other fusion mechanism.

selection: Unchanged v12c: strict improvement of selection incident_full global MAE subject to all four cohorts and all protected regional point MAEs <= A*1.001. Epoch 0 always available. No selection by local gain, diagnostics, audit outcome or best seed.

representation_probe.sample_rule: Evenly spaced integer linspace positions in eligible ordered fit indices; all when fewer than 64. Same positive fit subset for all arms/states, no target-based choice.
representation_probe.metrics: Regional MAE; candidate correction RMS, correction norm / injection norm, perpendicular-to-V correction norm / injection norm, post-LayerNorm change RMS, frozen context modifier mean/std, zero injection count. Store per-sample/node arrays. Undefined relative norms at V=0 use NaN and explicit valid counts. No optimizer steps or new gradients; isolate diagnostic RNG.
representation_probe.boundary: Fixed descriptive subset, not whole-fit performance or graph causal attribution. Local off-mask injection is exact native ICSF; downstream graph/decoder predictions can still change off-mask and at late horizons.

audit: Report every seed and arm against A and both vectors against strength, interaction_vector against state_vector, all cohorts/regions with paired week and four-week-block intervals. No best-seed selection or independent-confirmation claim. Existing train-package audit weeks have repeatedly been inspected.
